notes.title: Who you gonna call? Bug Squishers!
notes.content:
[h1][u][b][i]Lost Legend --- Patch Notes 1.7.8[/i][/b][/u][/h1]

Hello everyone and welcome to the first official patch notes for Lost Legends! I (Elijah) will be compiling all the changes made to the game (starting with this version) and making patch notes so everyone knows what is updated, changed, or removed from the game as we release updates. This update will focus on some bug fixing and QoL improvements.

[i]Icon Updates:[/i]
-Small Gemstone
-Large Gemstone

[i]General Fixes:[/i]
-Fixed up cut-scenes
-Cleaned up some visuals to the maps

[i]Tutoria:[/i]
-Fixed directions for Joshua
-You can now rescue Sarah without starting the quest first

[i]Dawnfall:[/i]
-City visuals updated
-Winery updated
-House #3 added

[i]Chephren:[/i]
-There is now a health check before fighting with Dexter the second time
-Dexter now uses alchemy in all fights
-Innkeeper now give the correctly numbered keys

[i]Kastburg:[/i]
-The quest “Find Quinn” ending now works
-You can now complete the Shopping list quest without buying any of the items. They can be found around the city (you can still buy them).

[i]Fast Travel Update:[/i]
The fast travel system is getting an upgrade. We have decided to give the mailboxes in the game some functionality and we are linking it to the fast travel system. They way it will work is that you can send letters to Captain Wiley in order to change his location. That way, if you are in a city that he is not at yet, you can have him move. Here is what we have so far.
-Added event for mailboxes
-Connected to Captain Wiley event

notes.title: SPRING CLEANING UPDATE GOING LIVE!
notes.content:
As promised a week-or-so ago, [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/about]we're[/url] rolling out an update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend]Lost Legend[/url]. We've been working a lot on adding more to the story. It's been a long time since we've pushed an update, but that's because there's been a lot of stuff we've done that the player couldn't access yet. Now, the main story should have a lot more progression. 

Some music files have been changed to sound better, and a soundtrack will hopefully be available on the 28th of March! Mark your calendar! 

Some grammatical issues have been fixed. Some game-breaking bugs have been fixed. 

As [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]I[/url] said before, thank you for your continued support in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/864020/Lost_Legend]Lost Legend[/url] and in [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com]Unhinged LLC[/url]. We will post another update soon!

Thanks,

-  [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/adam]Adam[/url] and  [url=https://www.unhingedllc.com/brandon]Brandon[/url]

notes.title: Easter Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We've just made an update to Lost Legend. A few things have changed:

[list]
[*] Kastburg is closer to completion. This city is proving to be very difficult for us to finish. For some reason, making progress on this city requires more motivation than other things on the game.
[*] Cephren Town has been updated. We've changed some graphics and made characters more lively. 
[*] The introduction has been scrapped and changed to one that better connects the player to our main character. 
[*] The option of a male protagonist, Kolton, is completely phased out once and for all: we've decided that our story's hero is female.
[*] A multitude of other small changes, like fixing spelling mistakes and such. 
[/list]

The game will remain [b]on sale until Sunday[/b] for those of you who still haven't purchased your copy. Thanks for everyone's support!

notes.content: It has occurred to us that some of you may not be able to open the game. We are very sorry about this and we are putting out an update TODAY to fix this and add a few more features. We want your experience to be the very best with Lost Legend and we appreciate everyone that has already purchased the game. Thank you all and we hope to see some great feedback from the community.
